newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Indo-Bangla treaty on the Ganges water sharing will be placed in the next session of the parliament, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said.

Indian External Affairs Minister I K Gujral has said the water sharing treaty is not linked to any other issue. There was no "secret clause" and "there has been no trade off of any kind" between the two countries, he added.
Indian Prime Minister H D Deve Gowda would soon visit Bangladesh, Foreign Secretary Farooq Sobhan said on Friday.
British Prime Minister John Major may lead a UK trade team to Bangladesh next month.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina sought cooperation from all quarters to build a hunger-free Bangladesh for which, she said, the nation fought the liberation war.
Fundamentalist Jamaat-e-Islami party termed the Indo-Bangla water sharing treaty a "big hoax".
Workers at Mongla port enforced a half-day strike on Friday to press their 11-point demand including pay-hike and festival bonus.
Bangladesh's central bank issues on Saturday a 10-taka bank note commemorating the silver jubilee of the liberation war.
